headline: Electronic invoicing: deadlines for businesses are changing – All the details
summary: Deadlines are changing for the start of mandatory electronic invoicing for businesses with turnover below 1,000,000 euros. The article also covers other changes to the schedule.
why: Mandatory e-invoicing rules affect compliance costs and cash flow for small and mid-sized businesses and tax collection.
